text: Bitcoin's slight decline paired with Ethereum's flat performance suggests consolidation rather than conviction, with neither major moving decisively in either direction. The Fear & Greed index at 34 indicates underlying anxiety, though the recent 4-point uptick hints at modest recovery in sentiment. Bitcoin dominance holding steady at 56% and moderate total volume of $45B reflect a market waiting for clearer directional signals rather than panicking or committing fresh capital.
